cues.en: Hi. In this video, we're going to test the OpenAI Ultrafast mode in Microsoft Agent Framework and see how much it actually matters.
cues.zh: 大家好，這次會在 Microsoft Agent Framework 中測試 OpenAI Ultrafast 模式，看看實際有多少差異。

cues.en: So what is Ultrafast mode?
cues.zh: 什麼是 Ultrafast 模式呢？

cues.en: Well, on OpenAI's dev days in late September 2026, they introduced Ultrafast mode.
cues.zh: OpenAI 在 2026 年九月底的 DevDay 介紹了這個模式。

cues.en: And if we go to the page about it, we can go in and see that Ultrafast mode, other than something for codecs and stuff like that, is also something in the API.
cues.zh: 到官方頁面可以看到，除了 Codex 等工具，API 也支援 Ultrafast。

cues.en: And it's essentially just a new service tier.
cues.zh: 本質上，它就是新的服務層級。

cues.en: They claim it is eight times faster.
cues.zh: 官方宣稱速度快八倍。

cues.en: We will test that.
cues.zh: 我們來實際測試。

cues.en: And we can only use it with Astra at the moment, but Sol will also get access later on.
cues.zh: 目前只能搭配 Astra，之後 Sol 也會支援。

cues.en: They write 5.6 Sol, despite the 6 and 6.1 Sol is already out.
cues.zh: 文件寫的是 5.6 Sol，雖然 6 與 6.1 Sol 已經推出。

cues.en: But I guess new models in general will begin to use them.
cues.zh: 不過我猜新模型都會逐漸支援。

cues.en: What they talk about here is also we don't have too many tokens per minute we can do this on.
cues.zh: 這裡也提到，Ultrafast 可使用的每分鐘 Token 額度比較少。

cues.en: So if you normally get tokens per minute, these numbers are lower if you turn on Ultrafast mode.
cues.zh: 也就是啟用後，Token-per-minute 限制會比一般模式低。

cues.en: Not a problem here for our small little tests.
cues.zh: 對這次的小型測試不是問題。

cues.en: So they tend to just say it's the service tier, and it's just called Ultrafast instead of the normal flex and standard and so on.
cues.zh: 設定上只是新的 ServiceTier，名稱叫 Ultrafast，而不是原本的 Flex、Standard 等。

cues.en: And if we have a look at the pricing, that's the drawback, of course, standard.
cues.zh: 再看價格，這當然是它的缺點。

cues.en: Here we can see Astra costs $10 per million tokens in and 50 per million tokens out.
cues.zh: Astra 的 Standard 價格是每百萬輸入 Token 十美元，輸出五十美元。

cues.en: We then have had the fast mode that has always been double the price.
cues.zh: 之前的快速模式，一直是兩倍價格。

cues.en: And now we have Ultrafast, which is six times the price.
cues.zh: 現在 Ultrafast 則是六倍。

cues.en: So it's a very expensive thing, and it's only on the big models.
cues.zh: 因此非常昂貴，而且只有大型模型能使用。

cues.en: But let's see in code how much it actually impacts and if this eight times faster is correct.
cues.zh: 接著看看程式碼與實際差異，是否真的快八倍。

cues.en: So I've made in my normal sample repo an OMA response API Ultrafast mode.
cues.zh: 範例儲存庫中，我建立了 OpenAI Responses API Ultrafast Mode。

cues.en: And I'm using my agent framework toolkit here, which has been updated to support this, because we can easily set the service tier here.
cues.zh: 這裡使用我已更新支援此功能的 Agent Framework Toolkit，方便直接設定 ServiceTier。

cues.en: Right now, you can see it's set to default, but we can set it to the new Ultrafast.
cues.zh: 目前是 Default，也可以改成新的 Ultrafast。

cues.en: But before we do that, let's quickly have a look at two questions here and how long time they take running in normal mode.
cues.zh: 但先看看兩個問題在一般模式下，各自需要多久。

cues.en: I will just run it here.
cues.zh: 先執行。

cues.en: And our first question is already in.
cues.zh: 第一個問題已經送出。

cues.en: What is the capital of France?
cues.zh: 「法國首都是哪裡？」

cues.en: Took 2.42 seconds.
And the second is a much harder, not harder, but difficult.
cues.zh: 第二個比較複雜，或者說不是更難，

cues.en: Many tokens are generated, so a 1,000-word essay about how cool docs are.
cues.zh: 而是需要產生大量 Token：寫一篇一千字的文章，說明狗有多棒。

cues.en: And when we get that result back, I have just put in that I only show this first 100 characters so we don't get a wall of text here, but it will generate them all, of course.
cues.zh: 回覆後，我只顯示前一百個字元，避免畫面塞滿文字，但模型仍然會完整生成。

cues.en: So let's see how long it takes for the normal mode to do this.
cues.zh: 看看一般模式需要多久。

cues.en: And of course, we're using Astra because that's the only one that's supported yet, at least.
cues.zh: 當然使用 Astra，因為目前只有它支援 Ultrafast。

cues.en: So we see that we roughly used 50 seconds or 47.3 seconds.
cues.zh: 大約五十秒，實際這次是 47.3 秒。

cues.en: Cool. Let's try with Ultrafast. Doing the same.
cues.zh: 好，改用 Ultrafast，執行相同任務。

cues.en: Eight times faster, they claim, at six times the price.
cues.zh: 官方宣稱快八倍，價格則是六倍。

cues.en: But we saw that for 2.4 and 47.
cues.zh: 剛才兩個結果約是 2.4 秒與 47 秒。

cues.en: First up, 1.86.
cues.zh: 第一個問題，這次是 1.86 秒。

cues.en: That was definitely not eight times faster.
cues.zh: 顯然沒有快到八倍。

cues.en: We will talk a little about why that is.
cues.zh: 稍後會說明原因。

cues.en: But the other one down here, come back in 12 seconds.
cues.zh: 下方第二個問題，則在十二秒內完成。

cues.en: So what is that?
cues.zh: 這代表大概多少呢？

cues.en: Five, six times faster, eight times faster.
cues.zh: 大約快了幾倍，而不一定剛好八倍。

cues.en: Of course, they can't guarantee one debt on the money eight times faster, but that is what they can claim.
cues.zh: 當然不可能每次都精準保證快八倍，那是官方宣稱的效能表現。

cues.en: Here at the top, because it's a very simple question, I think it's all about networking behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 上方問題非常簡單，我認為主要時間都花在網路往返。

cues.en: So traffic back and forward, and they can make that faster.
cues.zh: 請求與回覆的網路傳輸，並不會因此變快。

cues.en: It's only the token users that can actually be faster.
cues.zh: 能變快的是 Token 的生成。

cues.en: And the same way down here.
cues.zh: 下方也同樣受到一些固定開銷影響。

cues.en: But we can definitely see that we went from 50 seconds down to 10 to 12.
cues.zh: 但確實能看到，從接近五十秒縮短到十至十二秒。

cues.en: I've seen it down to 10, depending on when I run this as well.
cues.zh: 我也看過十秒的結果，取決於執行當下。

cues.en: And we're not really doing anything special.
cues.zh: 而且程式沒有做任何特別處理。

cues.en: We're just using the normal run async with a question and getting the response back.
cues.zh: 只是一般 RunAsync，傳入問題，再取得回覆。

cues.en: So the only thing we're doing is setting the service tier.
cues.zh: 唯一更動的就是 ServiceTier。

cues.en: And if you're not using Agent Framework Toolkit, my open source package on top, of course, it can be done manually.
cues.zh: 如果沒有使用我的開源 Agent Framework Toolkit，當然也能手動設定。

cues.en: It's just a little more cumbersome in that you get your OpenAI client, you say response as client, as AI client, and then you get the response back.
cues.zh: 只是較繁瑣：從 OpenAIClient 取得 Responses Client，再轉成 AI Client，

cues.en: You say response as client, as AI client, and underneath chat options, you can set the raw representation factory to the create options
cues.zh: 然後在 ChatOptions 裡，讓 RawRepresentationFactory 回傳 CreateResponseOptions，

cues.en: where you can then finally set the service tier.
cues.zh: 最後才能設定 ServiceTier。

cues.en: And speaking of service tier, this is, of course, only an OpenAI feature.
cues.zh: 說到 ServiceTier，這當然是 OpenAI 專屬功能。

cues.en: If you try to use this in Azure OpenAI, it will not work.
cues.zh: 如果用在 Azure OpenAI，不會生效。

cues.en: Microsoft have its own service tiers that you don't specify in the models here, but specify when you do the deployments instead.
cues.zh: Microsoft 有自己的服務層級，但不是在這裡指定，而是在部署模型時設定。

cues.en: So this is only if you're using OpenAI.
cues.zh: 所以這裡只適用 OpenAI。

cues.en: And as we just saw in a small question like this, the big overhead is the request response anyway, so we don't really get anything out there.
cues.zh: 剛才也看到，簡單問題的主要開銷是請求往返，所以提升不大。

cues.en: And then it's up to you, of course, if you feel like a thousand-word essay about how cool docs are is worth six times more for 50 seconds
cues.zh: 至於一千字的狗狗文章，要把接近五十秒的等待，

cues.en: compared to a 12-second response.
cues.zh: 縮短到十二秒，是否值得六倍價格，就由你決定。

cues.en: In certain cases, it might be. In other cases, it absolutely won't.
cues.zh: 某些情境可能值得，其他情境則完全不值得。

cues.en: But beyond that, it's nothing special.
cues.zh: 除此之外，沒有什麼特別的。

cues.en: It's not like we need to send anything in a different manner other than the service tier. So with that, thank you.
cues.zh: 不必用不同方式傳送資料，只要設定 ServiceTier。謝謝收看，

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下支影片見。
